size.value: 5 x 7 cm (identity/passport standard size, per Polícia Federal / Itamaraty)

background.value: White background (fundo branco), photo taken facing forward

head_height.value: Chin-to-forehead length (comprimento do queixo à testa) must be between 31 and 36 mm

validity.value: Recent photo, preferably taken less than 6 months prior

glasses_policy.value: Lenses must not reflect ambient or camera light; sunglasses or thick/flashy frames are not permitted under any circumstances

face_visibility.value: Face and shoulders fully framed by the camera, applicant looking directly at camera, eyes open and visible; no reflections, penumbra, or shadows anywhere in the photo

expression.en: Neutral expression required; eyes open and clearly visible
expression.ko: 무표정(중립적 표정)을 유지해야 하며, 눈은 뜬 상태로 뚜렷하게 보여야 함
expression.ja: 無表情(中立的な表情)を保ち、目は開けてはっきり見えること

glasses.en: Glasses lenses must not reflect ambient or camera light; sunglasses and thick or flashy frames are not permitted
glasses.ko: 안경 렌즈에 주변광이나 카메라 조명이 반사되면 안 되며, 선글라스나 두껍고 화려한 테의 안경은 착용 불가(무반사 원칙)
glasses.ja: 眼鏡のレンズに周囲光やカメラの光が反射してはならず、サングラスや太い・派手なフレームの眼鏡は不可

face_visibility.en: Face and shoulders must be fully within frame, looking directly at the camera, with no shadows or reflections
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴과 어깨가 프레임 안에 완전히 들어와야 하며 카메라를 정면으로 응시하고, 그림자나 반사가 없어야 함
face_visibility.ja: 顔と肩が完全にフレーム内に収まり、カメラを正面から見て、影や反射がないこと

db_conflicts.research_value: 31-36mm chin-to-forehead (queixo à testa) — different measurement point and value

size.evidence: 5x7cm (50x70mm) is consistently confirmed across multiple gov.br/mre consular pages (consulado-atlanta, embaixada-sao-jose, consulado-chicago) as the standard Brazilian passport photo size — Brazil is a documented exception to the 35x45mm ICAO-style standard used by most countries.
